newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DISTILLERS GIVES AID TO BLACK MANAGERS.
newsitem.headline: DISTILLERS GIVES AID TO BLACK MANAGERS.

text.p: South Africa's brandy and spirits manufacturing group Distillers Corp Ltd on Wednesday donated 525,000 rand to help train the country's black managers, the company said.

The money was given to the University of South Africa's (UNISA) Centre for Business Management to train 90 managers during the next three years, Jan Scannell, the group's managing director, said in a statement.
"Without private sector assistance... far less progress would be made in advancing black managers in this country," UNISA's Annette de Klerk said in welcoming the sponsorship.
She said that government cuts in tertiary spending had severely curtailed their capacity to meet community advancement needs.
